formal_statement:
theorem ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.BandRawA.Stored.read {μ : ℕ → ℤ} {vals owners positions n g k : ℕ}
    {rs : List _root_.ThreeSum.BandCandidateRows.Record} {f : ℕ → ℤ}
    (H : _root_.ThreeSum1960614.Machine.ThreeSum.BandRawA.Stored μ vals owners positions f (_root_.ThreeSum.BandRawA.items n g rs))
    (hk : k < (_root_.ThreeSum.BandRawA.items n g rs).length) :
    μ (vals+k)=f (_root_.ThreeSum.BandRawA.labelAt n g rs k).position ∧
      μ (owners+k)=((_root_.ThreeSum.BandRawA.labelAt n g rs k).owner : ℤ) ∧
      μ (positions+k)=((_root_.ThreeSum.BandRawA.labelAt n g rs k).position : ℤ) := by sorry
natural_language_statement:
Let memory $\mu$ contain the parallel value, owner, and position arrays for the incidence list constructed from length $n$, band size $g$, records $R$, and original value map $f$. At every valid list index $k$, the three reads equal respectively $f$ at the labelled original position, its owner label, and its original position.

These reads let a physical wanted slot recover its original A value, owner label, and original input position.
